continuationDomain.sourceRef: continuity report §4.4, BOTH halves, applied per anthropic/claude-opus-5's own evidence. Own-state acceptance: a Claude model's own thinking blocks are replayed to it unchanged, in order, with signatures intact. Why the domain is NARROW: prior thinking/redacted_thinking blocks are tied to the model that produced them, so "same provider" is not automatically "same continuation domain" — the domain is this model alone.

pricing.sourceRef: https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/about-claude/pricing (301 → https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing; both retrieved 2026-09-08) — the vendor's own Model pricing table, row "Claude Fable 5.1": "Base input tokens $10 / MTok | 5m cache writes $12.50 / MTok | 1h cache writes $20 / MTok | Cache hits and refreshes $0.25 / MTok | Output tokens $50 / MTok", with the page's own footnote "Cache hits and refreshes on Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1 are priced at 0.025x the base input price. All other models use the standard 0.1x multiplier." P7a upgrade: this row previously cited the MODELS page, which states input/output and the cache-read multiplier but no cache-write rate (P6.6 could not reach the pricing page). `cacheWritePerMTokUsd` records the 5-MINUTE write ($12.50), matching every other Anthropic row here; the 1-hour write ($20) has no field of its own and is under-reported, exactly as `ModelPricing`'s one-rate-per-direction shape requires — a disclosed schema gap, not a claim the 1h rate does not exist. Batch (-50%), fast-mode and `inference_geo: "us"` (1.1x) modifiers are likewise unrepresentable and are NOT folded into these numbers.

readableState.sourceRef: continuity report §5.1, applied per anthropic/claude-opus-5's own evidence — the Messages API returns a readable thinking summary, never the raw chain, for every current Claude model

summaryRequest.sourceRef: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/thinking#progress-updates (read 2026-10-05) — "On Claude Fable 5.1, Claude Mythos 5.1, Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5.5, and Claude Fable 5, the model can write a progress update between tool calls"; `display: "updates"` (beta) returns reasoning blocks with an empty `thinking` field and each progress update as readable summary text, and "requires the beta header `thinking-display-updates-2026-08-18`" (without it the value is a 400). https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/thinking#controlling-thinking-display (read 2026-10-05) — `display` accepts "summarized", "omitted" (the default on this model) and "updates" (beta). Winter requests "updates" where this list carries it. Earlier evidence: derived-shapes-p6.md item (c) — ThinkingAdaptive/ThinkingEnabled `display`.

completionEvent.sourceRef: R6-D's pinned stream vocabulary, applied per anthropic/claude-opus-5's own evidence — a thinking block's signature arrives across signature_delta events, so the complete replayable block exists only at content_block_stop

continuationDomain.sourceRef: continuity report §4.4, BOTH halves, applied per anthropic/claude-opus-5's own evidence. Own-state acceptance: a Claude model's own thinking blocks are replayed to it unchanged, in order, with signatures intact. Why the domain is NARROW: prior thinking/redacted_thinking blocks are tied to the model that produced them, so "same provider" is not automatically "same continuation domain" — the domain is this model alone.

effortRequest.sourceRef: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/effort — the effort page's supportedModels list names claude-fable-5-1, claude-fable-5, claude-opus-5-5, claude-opus-5, claude-opus-4-8, claude-opus-4-7, claude-opus-4-6, claude-opus-4-5-20251101, claude-sonnet-5 and claude-sonnet-4-6: effort is requested through `output_config.effort` (Claude 4.7 and later reject a manual `thinking.budget_tokens`, https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/thinking-troubleshooting#rejected-configurations).

blockBinding.sourceRef: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/thinking-troubleshooting — "A 400 error says a thinking block signature is invalid": on Claude Fable 5.1 and Opus 5.5 a replayed thinking block is bound to the conversation (system, tools and earlier messages) and is rejected once that prefix changes (enforced for accounts created on or after 2026-08-31); the documented escape is the `thinking-binding-controls-2026-08-01` beta with `thinking.block_binding.prefix_mismatch_behavior: "drop_block"`. See also https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/opus-5-5/whats-new-opus-5-5 ("Thinking blocks are tied to the model and the conversation").

perMessageEffort.sourceRef: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/effort#change-effort-mid-conversation-beta — "On Claude Fable 5.1, Claude Mythos 5.1, Claude Opus 5.5, and Claude Opus 5, use a per-message effort change, which keeps the prompt cache": a role:"system" message with empty content and output_config.effort, beta header mid-conversation-output-config-2026-07-01; "Models without per-message effort, including Claude Fable 5, return a 400 error". claude 2.1.282 sends the older alias per-turn-control-2026-07-01, which the page does not document.

pricing.sourceRef: https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/about-claude/pricing (301 → https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing; both retrieved 2026-09-08) — the vendor's own Model pricing table, row "Claude Fable 5.1": "Base input tokens $10 / MTok | 5m cache writes $12.50 / MTok | 1h cache writes $20 / MTok | Cache hits and refreshes $0.25 / MTok | Output tokens $50 / MTok", with the page's own footnote "Cache hits and refreshes on Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1 are priced at 0.025x the base input price. All other models use the standard 0.1x multiplier." P7a upgrade: this row previously cited the MODELS page, which states input/output and the cache-read multiplier but no cache-write rate (P6.6 could not reach the pricing page). `cacheWritePerMTokUsd` records the 5-MINUTE write ($12.50), matching every other Anthropic row here; the 1-hour write ($20) has no field of its own and is under-reported, exactly as `ModelPricing`'s one-rate-per-direction shape requires — a disclosed schema gap, not a claim the 1h rate does not exist. Batch (-50%), fast-mode and `inference_geo: "us"` (1.1x) modifiers are likewise unrepresentable and are NOT folded into these numbers.

readableState.sourceRef: continuity report §6.1 — summary parts are identified by `part.thought === true`; the underlying chain is not exposed

summaryRequest.sourceRef: continuity report §6.1 — `config.thinkingConfig.includeThoughts: true` on generateContent. The field is a BOOLEAN, recorded here as its single enabling spelling because the schema's `values` is a string list; the Interactions API's `generation_config.thinking_summaries` is a different surface and is not claimed for this endpoint.

continuationDomain.sourceRef: continuity report §6.1, BOTH halves. Own-state acceptance: a `thoughtSignature` is returned to the SAME model on its exact original part — "do not concatenate signed parts; do not move a signature to a different part; preserve every accumulated signature in a sequential function-call turn". Why the domain is NARROW: "A Gemini summary can be forwarded to another family. The `thoughtSignature` cannot." Signatures are bound to their exact part and model, so the domain is this model alone.

pricing.sourceRef: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing — Gemini 2.5 Pro paid tier, prompts <= 200k tokens: input $1.25, output $10.00, context-cache read $0.125 per 1M tokens. TIERED UPSTREAM: prompts > 200k are billed $2.50 / $15.00 / $0.25. `ModelPricing` has one rate per direction, so the STANDARD (<=200k) tier is recorded and cost is UNDER-reported for prompts above it — a disclosed schema gap (PROVENANCE.md), not a claim that the higher tier does not exist.
